RJD Supporters Allegedly Disrupt Inaugurated Bihar Bridge

Hours after Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Nitish Setu bridge in Bihar, alleged supporters of the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) created a disturbance on the bridge. The incident occurred shortly after the inauguration ceremony.
